text:
maria: Quick sync — packaging team prepping private/VPC installer bundle (v1.4.3-priv). Target change window: 2024-05-02 02:00 UTC. Need final transport and signing checks before handoff.

sam: copying the checklist here: cosign sign, shrinkwrap -> tarball, manifest delta generation, KMS tag, upload to staging mirror.

cheng: deploy-bot ran preflight earlier, two warnings on chunking heuristics but nothing blocking. 

deploy-bot: Preflight results for bundle v1.4.3-priv:
- images: all present
- checksums: 12 files
- cosign: unsigned (waiting)
- sizing: total 1.9GB
- note: delta manifest created: delta-20240501.json

katie: @sam can you attach the signed manifest and the shrinkwrap hash here when ready? ops needs the hash to check on their side. :clipboard: 

sam: pushing signed artifacts to staging now. cosign command used:
```
cosign sign --key ksm://projects/redwood/keys/deploy-priv v1.4.3-priv-manifest.json
```
sha256 (shrinkwrap): sha256:9f4b2a7c5d1e7e3b9a8c4c2f0a1d6b7c8e9f0a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0e1f2a3

ops-ian: Got the hash. I'll run transport verify against the on-prem mirror tonight (non-blocking). If cosign verification fails on customer side, plan is to revert to v1.4.2-priv signed bundle and open a hotfix packaging run. 

maria: Decision note: canary will be 3 nodes in staging region eu-west-2 first, then expand after 30m stable. Rollback criteria: >2% install failures or any checksum mismatch reported by on-prem verifier. 

cheng: small ask — when you upload to the private mirror, tag with both `v1.4.3-priv` and `priv-20240502` so operators can reference either. Avoid mutable latest.

sam: uploaded and pinned tags: `v1.4.3-priv`, `priv-20240502` and pushed submanifest: submanifest-priv-20240502.json (cosigned). Link: https://staging-mirror.redwood/internal/v1.4.3-priv

deploy-bot: Deploy plan registered:
- window: 2024-05-02 02:00 UTC
- canary: 3 nodes eu-west-2
- cutoff: 30m
- fallback: auto-pin to v1.4.2-priv on failure

katie: release notes short blurb for the PM site: "Private/VPC installer v1.4.3 — airgap packaging improvements, smaller delta manifests, and improved cosign verification flow." I'll paste full notes in GH issue.

ops-ian: I'll do the mirror verify at 23:00 UTC tonight and report back. If anything looks off I'll raise an emergency packaging job.

maria: Thanks. Final checklist for tomorrow:
- [x] cosign sign completed
- [x] shrinkwrap SHA recorded
- [x] tags pinned
- [ ] ops mirror verify (23:00 UTC)
- [ ] canary start + 30m observation

cheng: ack. ping this thread when canary starts so I can watch logs.

ops-ian: mirror verify done: all checksums OK, cosign verification passed with KMS signer id "redwood-deploy-priv". No blockers.

maria: Perfect. I'll kick the rollout at 02:00 UTC and update the release issue. :rocket:

sam: leaving a note: if we see any installer-level failures tied to tar extraction on RHEL 8, fallback will be to repackage with `--no-xattrs` and repush.

maria: copy that. Thanks everyone.
